headline: Germany's Bafin Censures Hypoport 2023 Accounts, Shares Plunge Up to 6%
summary: Germany's financial watchdog Bafin censured Hypoport's 2023 consolidated financial statements after finding pre-tax results were overstated by at least €10 million, sending shares tumbling up to 6%.
why: Hypoport is a technology-based financial service provider; regulatory accounting censures trigger immediate risk reassessments and valuation contractions.

impacts.name: Hypoport SE
impacts.why: A formal regulatory rebuke over overstated earnings directly triggered a sharp drop in share price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Regulatory censure regarding material overstatements in past financial reports severely damaged market trust, causing the stock to plunge.
